hooks.command: input=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'jq required for the protected-path guard — install jq.' >&2; exit 2; }; f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env.example|*.env.sample|*.env.template) ;; *.env|*/.env|*.env.*|*lock.json|*lock.yaml|*.lock) echo "Blocked: $f is a protected path — change it by hand." >&2; exit 2;; */migrations/*) git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "Blocked: $f is an existing (tracked) migration — migrations are immutable, create a new one instead." >&2; exit 2; };; esac
echo 'PreCompact: flush migration/upgrade state to .claude/state/MIGRATION_STATE.md / UPGRADE_PLAN.md now — completed modules, target mappings, decisions, blockers — so nothing is summarized away.'
